turns.response_html: Acetone is an organic compound with the chemical formula $C_3H_6O$ and is the simplest ketone. It is a colorless, highly volatile, and flammable liquid with a distinctive, pungent odor. As a powerful solvent, it is widely used in industrial and household products like nail polish remover and paint thinner. The human body also naturally produces small amounts of acetone as a byproduct of metabolism.
